title: The ring of rational functions of a scheme with finitely many irreducible components
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the ring of rational functions of a scheme with finitely many irreducible components as the product of the local rings at the generic points, identifies it with the product of the residue fields when the scheme is reduced, and reduces it to a single field generated by the local ring for an integral scheme. The proof takes an open dense subset and cuts it down to nonempty open pieces meeting exactly one component, then rewrites the colimit defining rational functions as a product of colimits over those pieces, using that morphisms to the affine line are the same as global sections; the reduced and integral statements follow from the product decomposition and the single-component case.
